name: codestar-connections
description: AWS CodeStar Connections This Amazon Web Services CodeStar Connections API Reference provides descriptions and usage examples of the operations and data types for the Amazon Web Services CodeStar Connections API.

subcommands.name: create-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a connection that can then be given to other Amazon Web Services services like CodePipeline so that it can access third-party code repositories.

subcommands.name: create-host
subcommands.description: Creates a resource that represents the infrastructure where a third-party provider is installed.

subcommands.name: create-repository-link
subcommands.description: Creates a link to a specified external Git repository.

subcommands.name: create-sync-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a sync configuration which allows Amazon Web Services to sync content from a Git repository to update a specified Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: delete-connection
subcommands.description: The connection to be deleted.

subcommands.name: delete-host
subcommands.description: The host to be deleted.

subcommands.name: delete-repository-link
subcommands.description: Deletes the association between your connection and a specified external Git repository.

subcommands.name: delete-sync-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the sync configuration for a specified repository and connection.

subcommands.name: get-connection
subcommands.description: Returns the connection ARN and details such as status, owner, and provider type.

subcommands.name: get-host
subcommands.description: Returns the host ARN and details such as status, provider type, endpoint, and, if applicable, the VPC configuration.

subcommands.name: get-repository-link
subcommands.description: Returns details about a repository link.

subcommands.name: get-repository-sync-status
subcommands.description: Returns details about the sync status for a repository.

subcommands.name: get-resource-sync-status
subcommands.description: Returns the status of the sync with the Git repository for a specific Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: get-sync-blocker-summary
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the most recent sync blockers.

subcommands.name: get-sync-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns details about a sync configuration, including the sync type and resource name.

subcommands.name: list-connections
subcommands.description: Lists the connections associated with your account.

subcommands.name: list-hosts
subcommands.description: Lists the hosts associated with your account.

subcommands.name: list-repository-links
subcommands.description: Lists the repository links created for connections in your account.

subcommands.name: list-repository-sync-definitions
subcommands.description: Lists the repository sync definitions for repository links in your account.

subcommands.name: list-sync-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of sync configurations for a specified repository.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Gets the set of key-value pairs (metadata) that are used to manage the resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds to or modifies the tags of the given resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: update-host
subcommands.description: Updates a specified host with the provided configurations.

subcommands.name: update-repository-link
subcommands.description: Updates the association between your connection and a specified external Git repository.

subcommands.name: update-sync-blocker
subcommands.description: Allows you to update the status of a sync blocker, resolving the blocker and allowing syncing to continue.

subcommands.name: update-sync-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the sync configuration for your connection and a specified external Git repository.
